chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Al-Mu‘allā ibn Muhammad, from Bistām ibn Murrah, from Isḥāq ibn Ḥassān, from Al-Haytham ibn Wāqid, from ‘Alī ibn Al-Ḥusayn Al-‘Abdī, from Sa‘d Al-Iskāf, from Al-Aṣbagh ibn Nubātah, who said:

Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: “What is the matter with people who changed the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and turned away from his legatee? Do they not fear that the punishment may descend upon them?”
Then he recited this verse: “Have you not seen those who exchanged the favor of Allah for disbelief and caused their people to dwell in the abode of ruin—Hell?”
Then he said: “We are the favor with which Allah has blessed His servants, and through us whoever succeeds will succeed on the Day of Resurrection.”

key_terms.سُنَّةَ: the normative prophetic tradition and ordained way of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نِعْمَةَ: the divine favor bestowed upon the servants of Allah
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and final judgment

ai.seo_question: How does Imam ‘Alī عليه السلام interpret Allah’s “favor” in Qur’an 14:28?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a condemnation of those who altered the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and turned away from his وصيّ, linking their action to the Qur’anic description of exchanging Allah’s favor for disbelief. Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام identifies that divine favor as the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, through whom salvation and success on the Day of Resurrection are attained.
